title: Highly Effective HIV Drug to Be Offered at Low Cost to Poor Countries
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: A yearly two-shot treatment shown to be highly effective in preventing HIV infections is to be offered at low cost to people in 120 poor nations.
sentences.zh: 每年为120个贫穷国家的人提供两发治疗,显示在预防艾滋病毒感染方面非常有效,费用低廉。

sentences.en: Experts have called the treatment the closest the world has ever come to developing a vaccine against HIV.
sentences.zh: 专家们称治疗是世界上最接近于研制艾滋病毒疫苗的。

sentences.en: HIV stands for human immunodeficiency virus.
sentences.zh: 艾滋病毒代表人体免疫机能丧失病毒。

sentences.en: It is an infection that destroys cells of a person’s immune system and makes it difficult for them to fight off diseases.
sentences.zh: 这种感染会摧毁一个人的免疫系统的细胞,使他们难以防治疾病。

sentences.en: The HIV virus can progress to the related disease AIDS.
sentences.zh: 艾滋病毒可以向相关的艾滋病发展。

sentences.en: The World Health Organization (WHO) explains that AIDS is a term used to describe “the most advanced stages of HIV infection.”
sentences.zh: 世界卫生组织(卫生组织)解释说,艾滋病是一个用来描述“艾滋病毒感染最先进的阶段”的术语。

sentences.en: American-based drugmaker Gilead is the developer of the medication, called lenacapavir.
sentences.zh: 以美国为基地的制药商Gilead是药品的开发商,叫做Lenacapavir。

sentences.en: The drug is already sold under the name Sunlenca to treat HIV infections in the U.S., Canada, Europe and elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 在美国、加拿大、欧洲和其他地方,该药物已经以Sunlenca的名义出售,用于治疗艾滋病毒感染。

sentences.en: But Gilead plans to seek approval soon for the medication to be used to prevent HIV infection.
sentences.zh: 但Gilead计划尽快申请批准使用该药物来预防艾滋病毒感染。

sentences.en: Studies have shown the twice-yearly injection was 100 percent effective in preventing HIV infections in a study of women.
sentences.zh: 研究表明,在一项妇女研究中,每年两次的注射在预防艾滋病毒感染方面是100%有效的。

sentences.en: And another recent study found the drug worked nearly as well in men.
sentences.zh: 最近的另一项研究发现,该药物在男性中几乎同样有效。

sentences.en: Winnie Byanyima is the executive director of UNAIDS.
sentences.zh: Winnie Byanyima是艾滋病规划署执行主任。

sentences.en: She told The Associated Press that the shots had worked so well, she sees them as an “ unprecedented ” treatment.
sentences.zh: 她告诉美联社,枪声效果很好,她认为枪声是一种“前所未有的”治疗。

sentences.en: Byanyima praised Gilead for developing the drug.
sentences.zh: Byanyema赞扬Gilead开发了这种药物。

sentences.en: But she noted that the world’s ability to stop HIV/AIDS also depends on its use in at-risk countries.
sentences.zh: 但是,她指出,世界遏制艾滋病毒/艾滋病的能力也取决于在风险国家中的使用。

sentences.en: Gilead has said it plans to offer low-cost, generic versions of lenacapavir for sale in numerous poor countries with high HIV rates.
sentences.zh: Gilead说,它计划提供低成本、通用的Lenacapavir,供许多艾滋病毒感染率高的贫穷国家销售。

sentences.en: These are mostly in Africa, Southeast Asia and the Caribbean.
sentences.zh: 这些国家大都在非洲、东南亚和加勒比。

sentences.en: However, the company does not plan on launching the drug in most of Latin America.
sentences.zh: 但是,该公司不打算在拉丁美洲大部分地区推出这种药物。

sentences.en: HIV infection rates are far lower in Latin America than Gilead’s targeted countries.
sentences.zh: 拉丁美洲的艾滋病毒感染率远低于Gilead的目标国家。

sentences.en: But critics of the drug company’s deployment plans say HIV in these countries is increasing.
sentences.zh: 但对制药公司部署计划的批评者说,这些国家艾滋病毒正在增加。

sentences.en: So several groups have called on Gilead to reconsider its plans to include sales in Latin America.
sentences.zh: 因此,有几个团体呼吁Gilead重新考虑将拉丁美洲的销售包括在内的计划。

sentences.en: In a recent report, the United Nations Programme on HIV/AIDS, UNAIDS, noted the number of AIDS death last year — an estimated 630,000 — was the lowest since 2004, when AIDS deaths were at their highest.
sentences.zh: 在最近一份报告中,联合国艾滋病毒/艾滋病方案(艾滋病方案)指出,去年艾滋病死亡人数——估计有630 000人——是2004年以来最低的,当时艾滋病死亡人数最高。

sentences.en: The organization suggested the decreasing numbers mean the world is now at “a historic crossroads ,” with a chance to end the epidemic.
sentences.zh: 该组织指出,人数的减少意味着世界现在处于“一个历史性的十字路口”,有机会结束这一流行病。

sentences.en: There are other methods to protect against HIV infection.
sentences.zh: 还有防止艾滋病毒感染的其他方法。

sentences.en: These include condoms , daily pills and bi-monthly shots.
sentences.zh: 其中包括避孕套、每日避孕药和双月射击。

sentences.en: But experts say the Gilead twice-yearly shots would be especially useful for underrepresented groups.
sentences.zh: 但专家说吉列德每年两次拍摄会特别有利于代表性不足的群体。

sentences.en: These could include people fearful of seeking care, including gay men, sex workers and young women.
sentences.zh: 这些人可能包括害怕寻求照顾的人,包括男同性恋者、性工作者和年轻妇女。

sentences.en: Byanyima told the AP, the treatment “would be a miracle for these groups because it means they just have to show up twice a year at a clinic and then they’re protected.”
sentences.zh: Byanyima告诉AP, “对于这些群体来说,治疗将是一个奇迹,因为这意味着他们每年必须在诊所出现两次,然后就受到保护。

sentences.en: A collection of 15 activist groups – in Peru, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Guatemala and Colombia – recently wrote to Gilead to voice their concerns.
sentences.zh: 包括秘鲁、阿根廷、厄瓜多尔、智利、危地马拉及哥伦比亚的15个活动团体,

sentences.en: They are asking for the generic version to be made available in Latin America.
sentences.zh: 他们要求在拉丁美洲提供通用版本。

sentences.en: They say there is “alarming” inequity there in providing new HIV prevention tools with infection rates rising.
sentences.zh: 他们说,在提供新的艾滋病毒预防工具方面存在着“紧张”的不公平现象,感染率在上升。

sentences.en: Countries including Norway, France, Spain and the U.S. have been paying more than $40,000 per year for Sunlenca.
sentences.zh: 挪威、法国、西班牙和美国等国家每年为Sunlenca支付40 000多美元。

sentences.en: But experts have said it could be produced for as little as $40 a treatment once generic production expands.
sentences.zh: 但专家说,一旦一般生产扩大,每生产40美元即可生产。

sentences.en: In a statement, Gilead said it has “an ongoing commitment to help enable access to HIV prevention and treatment options where the need is the greatest.” Among the 120 countries approved for the generic version are 18 mostly African nations that make up about 70 percent of the world’s HIV cases.
sentences.zh: 吉列德(Gilead)在一份声明中说,它“持续承诺帮助获得最需要的艾滋病毒预防和治疗选择。 ”在被批准采用通用版本的120个国家中,18个国家占非洲国家的70%左右,这些国家占了全世界艾滋病毒病例的70%。

sentences.en: The drugmaker said it is also working to establish “fast, efficient pathways to reach all people who need or want lenacapavir for HIV prevention.”
sentences.zh: 该名毒贩说,它也在努力建立“快速、有效的途径,以便接触所有需要或希望获得莱纳卡帕维的艾滋病毒预防服务的人”。

sentences.en: Dr. Chris Beyrer is the director of the Global Health Institute at Duke University in North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 克里斯·贝勒博士是北卡罗来纳杜克大学全球卫生研究所所长。

sentences.en: He said it will be greatly useful to have the Gilead shots available in the hardest-hit countries in Africa and Asia.
sentences.zh: 他说,在非洲和亚洲受打击最严重的国家提供Gilead照片将大有裨益。

sentences.en: But he added that rising HIV rates among groups including gay men and transgender populations represents “a public health emergency” in Latin America.
sentences.zh: 但是,他补充说,包括男同性恋和变性人口在内的群体中艾滋病毒感染率的上升是拉丁美洲的“公共卫生紧急情况”。

sentences.en: I’m Bryan Lynn. The Associated Press reported this story.
sentences.zh: 我是Bryan Lynn, 美联社报导了这个故事。

sentences.en: Bryan Lynn adapted the report for VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: Bryan Lynn改编了VOA学习英语的报告。
